coverage.target: Per-section loads, stale-answer drop and minimal reloads; real 20-load timing by u5 (performance-design.md P1, P4, P5)
Each section starts its own load on mount, no page-level await (performance-design.md P1)
Card reads start together on mount (performance-design.md P1)
5 s read and 12 s write limits in GuardrailsApi, timeout mapped to a typed failure (performance-design.md P2)
Working state set in the click handler plus a ref guard against a second press (performance-design.md P3)
Browser paging of plan and CI, server paging of audit, memoized derivations, windowing as fallback (performance-design.md P6, P7)
Route-level lazy loading and a recorded build size (performance-design.md P8)

Typed failures mapped to catalog keys; bodies and status text discarded (security-design.md S9)
Token read only by GuardrailsApi's one header function; never rendered, logged or addressed (security-design.md S2)
Token in memory, userId only in tab storage, refresh through the start path (security-design.md S1)
Call builders have no actor, role or user id parameter beyond the audit filter and start path (security-design.md S3)
Text children only, lint rules forbidding raw-HTML insertion (security-design.md S4)
One address builder with encodeURIComponent and URLSearchParams (security-design.md S5)
500-character box, blank check before sending, reason sent as typed (security-design.md S6)
